notes: The Advanced A.I. no longer freezes on searcher cards. Playing a card that looks at the top of its deck (Nami OP16-091 and others) could leave the bot thinking for many seconds — its practice playouts were spending nearly their whole budget re-attempting an attack the rules never allow. That decision is now near-instant, and the bot's choice on searches and effect targets is based on completed simulations instead of a cut-off guess. Also fixed: the Advanced A.I. locking up when a [Trigger] queued a follow-up decision, and every difficulty hanging before the first turn against a deck led by Imu (OP13-079), whose Stage play opens at the very start of the game. Finally, you are no longer handed the opponent's decisions in A.I. matches — the bot's deck-search 'Take None', its Choose A / Choose B branches, and Go First / Go Second after you lose the coin flip now show a waiting message instead of live buttons that decided things on the bot's behalf.
